# Contract: Update Checker

**Date**: 2026-03-22

## Overview

Manual update checking via `tauri-plugin-updater`. The app queries a static JSON endpoint on GitHub Releases and offers download + install if a newer version exists.

## Endpoint

**URL**: `https://github.com/iltan987/gelir-gider/releases/latest/download/latest.json`

**Method**: GET (handled internally by `tauri-plugin-updater`)

**Response** (generated by `tauri-apps/tauri-action`):

```json
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "notes": "Bug fixes and improvements",
  "pub_date": "2026-03-22T10:00:00Z",
  "platforms": {
    "windows-x86_64": {
      "signature": "<BASE64_SIGNATURE>",
      "url": "https://github.com/iltan987/gelir-gider/releases/download/app-v0.2.0/gelir-gider_0.2.0_x64-setup.nsis.zip"
    }
  }
}
```

**Fields**:
- `version` (required): Semver version string
- `notes` (optional): Release notes markdown
- `pub_date` (optional): ISO 8601 publication date
- `platforms` (required): Map of `{target}-{arch}` to download info
  - `signature` (required): Ed25519 signature of the update artifact
  - `url` (required): Direct download URL for the update file

## JavaScript API

```typescript
import { check } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-updater";
import { relaunch } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-process";

// Check for updates
const update = await check();
// Returns: Update | null

// If update available:
// update.version: string
// update.body: string | null (release notes)
// update.date: string | null (ISO date)

// Download and install with progress
await update.downloadAndInstall((event) => {
  switch (event.event) {
    case "Started":
      // event.data.contentLength: number (total bytes)
      break;
    case "Progress":
      // event.data.chunkLength: number (bytes in this chunk)
      break;
    case "Finished":
      break;
  }
});

// Relaunch after install
await relaunch();
```

## Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| No network | `check()` throws; catch and show "Baglanti hatasi" |
| Endpoint unreachable | `check()` throws; catch and show "Sunucuya ulasilamadi" |
| No update available | `check()` returns `null`; show "Guncel surum" |
| Signature mismatch | `downloadAndInstall()` throws; show "Guncelleme dogrulanamadi" |
| Download interrupted | `downloadAndInstall()` throws; show "Indirme basarisiz" |

## Security

- All updates are signed with Ed25519
- Public key embedded in `tauri.conf.json`
- Private key stored as GitHub Actions secret (`TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY`)
- TLS enforced in production (Tauri default)
- Signature verification happens before installation (Tauri default)

## UI States

```
idle -> [click "Guncelleme Kontrol Et"] -> checking
checking -> [no update] -> upToDate
checking -> [update found] -> available
checking -> [error] -> error
available -> [click "Guncelle"] -> downloading
downloading -> [complete] -> relaunch
downloading -> [error] -> error
error -> [click retry] -> checking
```
